blocks.zh: 函数 $u$ 在 $\Omega$ 内调和.
blocks.label: lem:perron-envelope-harmonic

source_locations.bbox_precision: visually selected parent block, top-left PDF points

blocks.en:
Let $\bm{x}$ be an arbitrary point in $\Omega$ and let $v_m$ be a sequence in $S_g$ such that $v_m(\bm{x})\to u(\bm{x})$. Clearly $v_m$ is bounded from above (by any supersolution), we may also assume it is bounded from below; if necessary, replace $v_m$ by $\max(v_m,v_0)$, where $v_0$ is any subsolution. Choose $R$ such that the closure of $B=B_R(\bm{x})$ is contained in $\Omega$ and let $V_m$ be the harmonic lifting of $v_m$ with respect to $B$. Then $V_m(\bm{x})\to u(\bm{x})$ and, by Theorem~\ref{thm:harmonic-sequence-compactness}, $V_m$ has a subsequence $V_{m_k}$ which converges on $B$ to a harmonic function $v$; the convergence is uniform on every compact subset of $B$. Clearly $v\leq u$ in $B$. We shall now show that in fact $v=u$ in $B$. This clearly implies the lemma.

Assume on the contrary that $v(\bm{y})<u(\bm{y})$ for some $\bm{y}\in B$. Then there exists a function $W\in S_g$ such that $v(\bm{y})<W(\bm{y})$. Let $w_k=\max(W,V_{m_k})$ and let $W_k$ be the harmonic lifting of $w_k$ with respect to $B$. As before, a subsequence of $W_k$ converges to a function $w$, harmonic in $B$. Then clearly $v\leq w$ on $B$ and $v(\bm{x})=w(\bm{x})$. By the maximum principle, this implies $v=w$ on $B$, contradicting the choice of $W$.
blocks.zh:
取 $\bm{x}$ 为 $\Omega$ 内任意一点, 并取 $S_g$ 中的序列 $v_m$, 使 $v_m(\bm{x})\to u(\bm{x})$. 显然 $v_m$ 有上界 (任意上解都是上界), 也可假设它有下界; 必要时用 $\max(v_m,v_0)$ 替换 $v_m$, 其中 $v_0$ 是任意下解. 选取 $R$, 使 $B=B_R(\bm{x})$ 的闭包包含于 $\Omega$ 内, 设 $V_m$ 为 $v_m$ 关于 $B$ 的调和提升. 那么 $V_m(\bm{x})\to u(\bm{x})$, 且由 Theorem~\ref{thm:harmonic-sequence-compactness}, $V_m$ 有子列 $V_{m_k}$, 在 $B$ 上收敛到调和函数 $v$; 收敛在 $B$ 的每个紧子集上都是一致的. 显然, $B$ 内有 $v\leq u$. 现在证明事实上 $B$ 内 $v=u$. 这显然蕴含引理.

反设对某个 $\bm{y}\in B$ 有 $v(\bm{y})<u(\bm{y})$. 那么存在函数 $W\in S_g$, 使 $v(\bm{y})<W(\bm{y})$. 令 $w_k=\max(W,V_{m_k})$, 并设 $W_k$ 为 $w_k$ 关于 $B$ 的调和提升. 与前面一样, $W_k$ 的一个子列收敛到 $B$ 内的调和函数 $w$. 显然在 $B$ 上 $v\leq w$, 且 $v(\bm{x})=w(\bm{x})$. 由最大值原理, 这蕴含在 $B$ 上 $v=w$, 与 $W$ 的选取矛盾.

blocks.en: Let $u$ be the harmonic function in $\Omega$ constructed above and let $\bm{\xi}\in\partial\Omega$. Then $u(\bm{x})\to g(\bm{\xi})$ as $\bm{x}\to\bm{\xi}$.
blocks.zh: 设 $u$ 为上述构造的 $\Omega$ 内的调和函数, 并设 $\bm{\xi}\in\partial\Omega$. 那么当 $\bm{x}\to\bm{\xi}$ 时, $u(\bm{x})\to g(\bm{\xi})$.
blocks.label: lem:perron-boundary-continuity

blocks.en: It is clear from the proof that the smoothness assumption on $\partial\Omega$ can be relaxed as long as barriers can be constructed. The above construction works for all convex domains. In other cases, alternative barriers are often available, see, e.g., Problem~\ref{ex:planar-local-logarithmic-barrier}.
blocks.zh: 由证明可见, 只要能够构造屏障, 就可以放宽 $\partial\Omega$ 的光滑性假设. 上述构造对所有凸区域都适用. 在其他情形下, 也常可找到其他屏障, 例如见 Problem~\ref{ex:planar-local-logarithmic-barrier}.

blocks.en: Let $\Omega=\{(x,y)\in\mathbb{R}^2\mid0<x^2+y^2<1\}$. Prove that there is no solution to the Dirichlet problem $\Delta u=0$ in $\Omega$, $u(\bm{x})=1$ for $x^2+y^2=1$, $u(0)=0$. Hint: Show first that if there is a solution, then there is also a radially symmetric solution.
blocks.zh: 令 $\Omega=\{(x,y)\in\mathbb{R}^2\mid0<x^2+y^2<1\}$. 证明 Dirichlet 问题在 $\Omega$ 内 $\Delta u=0$, 当 $x^2+y^2=1$ 时 $u(\bm{x})=1$, 且 $u(0)=0$, 无解. Hint: 先证明若存在解, 则也存在径向对称解.
blocks.label: ex:punctured-disk-dirichlet-nonexistence

blocks.en: A function $w$ is called a local barrier at $\bm{\xi}$ relative to $\Omega$ if the conditions (i) and (ii) in the definition hold only in some neighborhood $N$ of $\bm{\xi}$. Show that if there is a local barrier, there is a barrier. Hint: Let $B$ be a small ball centered at $\bm{\xi}$ and $m=\inf_{N\setminus B}w$. Define $\bar w=\min(m,w)$ on $B$ and $\bar w=m$ otherwise.
blocks.zh: 若定义中的条件 (i) 和 (ii) 只在 $\bm{\xi}$ 的某个邻域 $N$ 内成立, 则称函数 $w$ 为 $\bm{\xi}$ 处关于 $\Omega$ 的局部屏障. 证明若存在局部屏障, 则存在屏障. Hint: 取以 $\bm{\xi}$ 为球心的小球 $B$, 并令 $m=\inf_{N\setminus B}w$. 在 $B$ 上定义 $\bar w=\min(m,w)$, 在其他地方定义 $\bar w=m$.
blocks.label: ex:local-barrier-to-global-barrier

blocks.en: Let $\Omega$ be a domain in $\mathbb{R}^2$ with the origin on its boundary. Let $r$ and $\theta$ denote polar coordinates. Assume that a single-valued branch of $\theta$ exists in $\Omega\cap N$, where $N$ is a neighborhood of the origin. Show that a local barrier exists at the origin. Hint: Consider the analytic function $1/\log z$.
blocks.zh: 设 $\Omega$ 为 $\mathbb{R}^2$ 中的区域, 原点在其边界上. 设 $r$ 和 $\theta$ 表示极坐标. 假设在 $\Omega\cap N$ 内存在 $\theta$ 的单值分支, 其中 $N$ 为原点的一个邻域. 证明原点处存在局部屏障. Hint: 考虑解析函数 $1/\log z$.
blocks.label: ex:planar-local-logarithmic-barrier

blocks.en: Show that $\omega_n=\pi^{n/2}/\Gamma(\frac n2+1)$. Hint: Evaluate $\int_{\mathbb{R}^n}\exp(-|\bm{x}|^2)\,\mathrm{d}\bm{x}$ in both Cartesian and polar coordinates. By comparing the two expressions, you find a formula for $\Omega_n=n\omega_n$, the surface area of the unit sphere.
blocks.zh: 证明 $\omega_n=\pi^{n/2}/\Gamma(\frac n2+1)$. Hint: 分别在 Cartesian 坐标和极坐标中计算 $\int_{\mathbb{R}^n}\exp(-|\bm{x}|^2)\,\mathrm{d}\bm{x}$. 比较这两个表达式, 得到单位球面的面积 $\Omega_n=n\omega_n$ 的一个公式.
blocks.label: ex:unit-ball-volume-gamma-function
